verdict.rationale: Gusto is a payroll and financial SaaS that handles sensitive customer data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for it. The pack has no evidence of a training opt-out or a no-training policy. The robots.txt Content-Signal marker governs crawler use of Gusto's public website, not customer data, so it is an adjacent control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
